verses.original: וַיָּבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיַּצִּ֣יגוּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽטָה־ ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּקְרִ֛יבוּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yaṣ·ṣî·ḡū ’ō·ṯōw bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ō·hel ’ă·šer nā·ṭāh- lōw dā·wîḏ way·yaq·rî·ḇū ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·šə·lā·mîm lip̄·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So they brought the ark of God and placed it inside the tent that David had pitched for it And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God

verses.original: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔יד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal dā·wîḏ mê·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·haš·šə·lā·mîm way·ḇā·reḵ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings he blessed the people in the name of the LORD

verses.original: וַיְחַלֵּק֙ לְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֑ה לְאִישׁ֙ כִּכַּר־ לֶ֔חֶם וְאֶשְׁפָּ֖ר וַאֲשִׁישָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥal·lêq lə·ḵāl ’îš yiś·rā·’êl mê·’îš wə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh lə·’îš kik·kar- le·ḥem wə·’eš·pār wa·’ă·šî·šāh
verses.literal: Then he distributed to every . . . man and woman . . . of Israel a loaf of bread a date cake and a raisin cake

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתִ֑ים וּלְהַזְכִּיר֙ וּלְהוֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh min- hal·wî·yim mə·šā·rə·ṯîm ū·lə·haz·kîr ū·lə·hō·w·ḏō·wṯ ū·lə·hal·lêl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD to celebrate to give thanks and to praise the LORD the God of Israel

verses.original: אָסָ֥ף הָרֹ֖אשׁ וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ זְכַרְיָ֑ה יְעִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וּמַתִּתְיָ֡ה וֶאֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָהוּ֩ וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֜ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֗ל בִּכְלֵ֤י נְבָלִים֙ וּבְכִנֹּר֔וֹת וְאָסָ֖ף בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם מַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sāp̄ hā·rōš ū·miš·nê·hū zə·ḵar·yāh yə·‘î·’êl ū·šə·mî·rā·mō·wṯ wî·ḥî·’êl ū·mat·tiṯ·yāh we·’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm wî·‘î·’êl biḵ·lê nə·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ wə·’ā·sāp̄ bam·ṣil·ta·yim maš·mî·a‘
verses.literal: Asaph was the chief Zechariah was second then Jeiel Shemiramoth Jehiel Mattithiah Eliab Benaiah Obed-edom and Jeiel . . . They were to play the harps and lyres while Asaph sounded the cymbals

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֥הוּ וְיַחֲזִיאֵ֖ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בַּחֲצֹצְר֣וֹת תָּמִ֔יד לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū wə·ya·ḥă·zî·’êl hak·kō·hă·nîm ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ tā·mîḏ lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אָ֣ז נָתַ֤ן דָּוִיד֙ בָּרֹ֔אשׁ לְהֹד֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה בְּיַד־ אָסָ֖ף וְאֶחָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’āz nā·ṯan dā·wîḏ bā·rōš lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- ’ā·sāp̄ wə·’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: On that . . . day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this song of thanksgiving to the LORD

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִילֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh qir·’ū ḇiš·mōw hō·w·ḏî·‘ū ḇā·‘am·mîm ‘ă·lî·lō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD call upon His name make known His deeds among the nations

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לוֹ֙ זַמְּרוּ־ ל֔וֹ שִׂ֖יחוּ בְּכָל־ נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū lōw zam·mə·rū- lōw śî·ḥū bə·ḵāl nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Sing to Him sing praises to Him tell of all His wonders

verses.original: הִֽתְהַֽלְלוּ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֔וֹ יִשְׂמַ֕ח לֵ֖ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·hal·lū bə·šêm qā·ḏə·šōw yiś·maḥ lêḇ mə·ḇaq·šê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Glory in His holy name let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהוָה֙ וְעֻזּ֔וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖יו תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: dir·šū Yah·weh wə·‘uz·zōw baq·qə·šū p̄ā·nāw tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Seek out the LORD and His strength seek His face always

verses.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה מֹפְתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־ פִֽיהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mō·p̄ə·ṯāw ū·miš·pə·ṭê- p̄î·hū
verses.literal: Remember the wonders He has done His marvels and the judgments He has pronounced

verses.original: זֶ֚רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֔וֹ בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ra‘ yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḇ·dōw bə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·ḥî·rāw
verses.literal: O offspring of His servant Israel O sons of Jacob His chosen ones

verses.original: ה֚וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ miš·pā·ṭāw
verses.literal: He is the LORD our God His judgments carry throughout the earth

verses.original: זִכְר֤וּ לְעוֹלָם֙ בְּרִית֔וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū lə·‘ō·w·lām bə·rî·ṯōw dā·ḇār ṣiw·wāh lə·’e·lep̄ dō·wr
verses.literal: Remember His covenant forever the word He ordained for a thousand generations

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּעָת֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer kā·raṯ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām ū·šə·ḇū·‘ā·ṯōw lə·yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: the covenant He made with Abraham and the oath He swore to Isaac

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֤הָ לְיַעֲקֹב֙ לְחֹ֔ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏe·hā lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·ḥōq lə·yiś·rā·’êl bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree to Israel as an everlasting covenant

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנָ֔עַן חֶ֖בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr lə·ḵā ’et·tên ’e·reṣ- kə·nā·‘an ḥe·ḇel na·ḥă·laṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance

verses.original: בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר כִּמְעַ֖ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bih·yō·wṯ·ḵem mə·ṯê mis·pār kim·‘aṭ wə·ḡā·rîm bāh
verses.literal: When they were few in number few indeed and strangers in the land

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ֙ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־ גּ֔וֹי וּמִמַּמְלָכָ֖ה אֶל־ עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū mig·gō·w ’el- gō·w ū·mim·mam·lā·ḵāh ’el- ‘am ’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: they wandered from nation to nation from one kingdom to . . . another

verses.original: לֹא־ הִנִּ֤יחַ לְאִישׁ֙ לְעָשְׁקָ֔ם וַיּ֥וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- hin·nî·aḥ lə·’îš lə·‘ā·šə·qām way·yō·w·ḵaḥ ‘ă·lê·hem mə·lā·ḵîm
verses.literal: He let no man oppress them He rebuked kings on their behalf

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּמְשִׁיחָ֔י וּבִנְבִיאַ֖י אַל־ תָּרֵֽעוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tig·gə·‘ū bim·šî·ḥāy ū·ḇin·ḇî·’ay ’al- tā·rê·‘ū
verses.literal: Do not touch My anointed ones Do no harm to My prophets

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־ אֶל־ י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū Yah·weh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ baś·śə·rū mî·yō·wm- ’el- yō·wm yə·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD all the earth Proclaim His salvation day after day

verses.original: סַפְּר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֶת־ כְּבוֹד֔וֹ בְּכָל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: sap·pə·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw bə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Declare His glory among the nations His wonders among all peoples

verses.original: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהוָ֤ה וּמְהֻלָּל֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְנוֹרָ֥א ה֖וּא עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh ū·mə·hul·lāl mə·’ōḏ wə·nō·w·rā hū ‘al- kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised He is to be feared . . . above all gods

verses.original: כִּ֠י כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַיהוָ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘am·mîm ’ĕ·lî·lîm Yah·weh šā·ma·yim ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: For all the gods of the nations are idols but it is the LORD who made the heavens

verses.original: ה֤וֹד וְהָדָר֙ לְפָנָ֔יו עֹ֥ז וְחֶדְוָ֖ה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār lə·p̄ā·nāw ‘ōz wə·ḥeḏ·wāh bim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: Splendor and majesty are before Him strength and joy fill His dwelling

verses.original: הָב֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū Yah·weh miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ ‘am·mîm hā·ḇū Yah·weh kā·ḇō·wḏ wā·‘ōz
verses.literal: Ascribe to the LORD O families of the nations ascribe to the LORD glory and strength

verses.original: הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū Yah·weh kə·ḇō·wḏ šə·mōw śə·’ū min·ḥāh ū·ḇō·’ū lə·p̄ā·nāw hiš·ta·ḥă·wū Yah·weh bə·haḏ·raṯ- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name bring an offering and come before Him Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness

verses.original: חִ֤ילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אַף־ תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּבֵ֖ל בַּל־ תִּמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: ḥî·lū mil·lə·p̄ā·nāw kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ap̄- tik·kō·wn tê·ḇêl bal- tim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: tremble before Him all the earth . . . The world is firmly established it cannot be moved

verses.original: יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה מָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·mə·ḥū haš·šā·ma·yim wə·ṯā·ḡêl hā·’ā·reṣ wə·yō·mə·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim Yah·weh mā·lāḵ
verses.literal: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice Let them say among the nations The LORD reigns

verses.original: יִרְעַ֤ם הַיָּם֙ וּמְלוֹא֔וֹ יַעֲלֹ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yir·‘am hay·yām ū·mə·lō·w·’ōw ya·‘ă·lōṣ haś·śā·ḏeh wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- bōw
verses.literal: Let the sea resound and all that fills it let the fields exult and all that is in them

verses.original: אָ֥ז יְרַנְּנ֖וּ עֲצֵ֣י הַיָּ֑עַר מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־ בָ֖א לִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yə·ran·nə·nū ‘ă·ṣê hay·yā·‘ar mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh kî- ḇā liš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD for He is coming to judge the earth

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî ṭō·wḇ kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD for He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְאִמְר֕וּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֙נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔נוּ וְקַבְּצֵ֥נוּ וְהַצִּילֵ֖נוּ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לְהֹדוֹת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֔ךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּ֖חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im·rū hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘ê·nū wə·qab·bə·ṣê·nū wə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nū min- hag·gō·w·yim lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ lə·šêm qāḏ·še·ḵā lə·hiš·tab·bê·aḥ biṯ·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then cry out Save us O God of our salvation gather and deliver us from the nations that we may give thanks to Your holy name that we may glory in Your praise

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־ הָעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַ֣ד הָעֹלָ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ כָל־ הָעָם֙ אָמֵ֔ן וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl min- hā·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ hā·‘ō·lām way·yō·mə·rū ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ā·mên wə·hal·lêl Yah·weh
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD the God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting Then all the people said Amen and “Praise the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲזָב־ שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖ף וּלְאֶחָ֑יו לְשָׁרֵ֞ת לִפְנֵ֧י הָאָר֛וֹן תָּמִ֖יד לִדְבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zāḇ- šām lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh lə·’ā·sāp̄ ū·lə·’e·ḥāw lə·šā·rêṯ lip̄·nê hā·’ā·rō·wn tā·mîḏ liḏ·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD to minister there . . . regularly according to the daily . . . requirements

verses.original: וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֧ם בֶּן־ יְדִית֛וּן וְחֹסָ֖ה לְשֹׁעֲרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm wa·’ă·ḥê·hem šiš·šîm ū·šə·mō·w·nāh wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm ben- yə·ḏî·ṯūn wə·ḥō·sāh lə·šō·‘ă·rîm
verses.literal: along with Obed-edom and his sixty-eight . . . relatives Obed-edom son of Jeduthun and also Hosah were to be gatekeepers

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאֶחָיו֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה בַּבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wə·’e·ḥāw hak·kō·hă·nîm lip̄·nê miš·kan Yah·weh bab·bā·māh ’ă·šer bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon

verses.original: לְֽהַעֲלוֹת֩ עֹל֨וֹת לַיהוָ֜ה עַל־ מִזְבַּ֧ח הָעֹלָ֛ה תָּמִ֖יד לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעָ֑רֶב וּלְכָל־ הַכָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘ō·lō·wṯ Yah·weh ‘al- miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh tā·mîḏ lab·bō·qer wə·lā·‘ā·reḇ ū·lə·ḵāl- hak·kā·ṯūḇ bə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings morning and evening according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD which He had commanded . . . Israel to keep

verses.original: וְעִמָּהֶם֙ הֵימָ֣ן וִֽידוּת֔וּן וּשְׁאָר֙ הַבְּרוּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לְהֹדוֹת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘im·mā·hem hê·mān wî·ḏū·ṯūn ū·šə·’ār hab·bə·rū·rîm ’ă·šer niq·qə·ḇū bə·šê·mō·wṯ lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: With them were Heman Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְעִמָּהֶם֩ הֵימָ֨ן וִֽידוּת֜וּן חֲצֹצְר֤וֹת וּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ לְמַשְׁמִיעִ֔ים וּכְלֵ֖י שִׁ֣יר הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבְנֵ֥י יְדוּת֖וּן לַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘im·mā·hem hê·mān wî·ḏū·ṯūn ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ū·mə·ṣil·ta·yim lə·maš·mî·‘îm ū·ḵə·lê šîr hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇə·nê yə·ḏū·ṯūn laš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God And the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כָל־ הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֑וֹ וַיִּסֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד לְבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū ḵāl hā·‘ām ’îš lə·ḇê·ṯōw way·yis·sōḇ dā·wîḏ lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then all the people . . . departed for their homes and David returned home to bless his household
